## Summary

If a backend's kernel block sizes exclude the manager block size, `create_kv_cache_views` gives connectors a **kernel-block-split** 4-D view (leading dim in kernel blocks, `r = num_states / N`). MoRIIO's 4-D branch only accepts `r == 1`, so registration fails with `Unsupported MoRIIO MLA cache shape`.

Affected on `main`: DeepSeek-V3.2-style models on ROCm (e.g. GLM-5.2). `ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE` and `DEEPSEEK_V32_INDEXER` support kernel blocks `[1, MultipleOf(16)]`, so a `--block-size` that isn't 1 or a multiple of 16 (e.g. 8) is split to kernel block 1.

**Change** (`moriio_layout.py`, `get_layer_transfer_geometry`):
- Accept split views for single-head caches (MLA latent, indexer); group them with `group_kernel_blocks` so the geometry is in manager blocks. A dense single-head block is the same bytes for any kernel block size, so P and D may differ.
- Multi-head splits stay rejected (byte order depends on the layout).

Bit-identical for `r == 1`; no wire or metadata change. +17/−5 in one source file.

GLM-5.3-Flash no longer needs this since #57169 (packed layout, never split group-wide).

## Validation

- **Unit:** `test_moriio_kv_layout.py` 63 passed; all `test_moriio_*.py` 886 passed (`main`: 872). Kernel-split tests fail on `main`. New tests: ratio equivalence, real-allocator splits (GLM-5.2 MLA latent and indexer at block size 8, pooled indexer), allocator rejecting a padded split, multi-head rejection, non-divisible split, out-of-range block ids.
- **Lint:** pre-commit (ruff, mypy, typos) passes.
- **E2E:** GLM-5.2-FP8, MI300X, 1P1D (EP8 per node), MoRIIO; this PR `501baf943f` vs `main` `5d35ce3934`; GSM8K 5-shot, full:

| | block size | registration | GSM8K strict |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 1 | ok | 94.01 ± 0.65 |
| this PR | 1 | ok | 94.09 ± 0.65 |
| this PR | 8 | ok | 94.01 ± 0.65 |
| main | 8 | `Unsupported MoRIIO MLA cache shape ... (225096, 1, 1, 132)` | – |

- **Unaffected model:** GLM-5.3-Flash 1P1D (READ) with / without this PR: ratio 1 everywhere, GSM8K 91.28 vs 91.51.

Commands and outputs: see the review thread.

## Checklist

- [x] AI assistance used (Claude); commits carry `Co-authored-by: Claude`.
- [x] Design fit: one source file (plus tests); no core, scheduler or model-runner changes.
- [x] Tests: unit incl. real-allocator cases; E2E with/without the split, and an unaffected model.
- [x] Style: ruff, mypy, typos pass.

detail.body:
## Summary

If a backend's kernel block sizes exclude the manager block size, `create_kv_cache_views` gives connectors a **kernel-block-split** 4-D view (leading dim in kernel blocks, `r = num_states / N`). MoRIIO's 4-D branch only accepts `r == 1`, so registration fails with `Unsupported MoRIIO MLA cache shape`.

Affected on `main`: DeepSeek-V3.2-style models on ROCm (e.g. GLM-5.2). `ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE` and `DEEPSEEK_V32_INDEXER` support kernel blocks `[1, MultipleOf(16)]`, so a `--block-size` that isn't 1 or a multiple of 16 (e.g. 8) is split to kernel block 1.

**Change** (`moriio_layout.py`, `get_layer_transfer_geometry`):
- Accept split views for single-head caches (MLA latent, indexer); group them with `group_kernel_blocks` so the geometry is in manager blocks. A dense single-head block is the same bytes for any kernel block size, so P and D may differ.
- Multi-head splits stay rejected (byte order depends on the layout).

Bit-identical for `r == 1`; no wire or metadata change. +17/−5 in one source file.

GLM-5.3-Flash no longer needs this since #57169 (packed layout, never split group-wide).

## Validation

- **Unit:** `test_moriio_kv_layout.py` 63 passed; all `test_moriio_*.py` 886 passed (`main`: 872). Kernel-split tests fail on `main`. New tests: ratio equivalence, real-allocator splits (GLM-5.2 MLA latent and indexer at block size 8, pooled indexer), allocator rejecting a padded split, multi-head rejection, non-divisible split, out-of-range block ids.
- **Lint:** pre-commit (ruff, mypy, typos) passes.
- **E2E:** GLM-5.2-FP8, MI300X, 1P1D (EP8 per node), MoRIIO; this PR `501baf943f` vs `main` `5d35ce3934`; GSM8K 5-shot, full:

| | block size | registration | GSM8K strict |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 1 | ok | 94.01 ± 0.65 |
| this PR | 1 | ok | 94.09 ± 0.65 |
| this PR | 8 | ok | 94.01 ± 0.65 |
| main | 8 | `Unsupported MoRIIO MLA cache shape ... (225096, 1, 1, 132)` | – |

- **Unaffected model:** GLM-5.3-Flash 1P1D (READ) with / without this PR: ratio 1 everywhere, GSM8K 91.28 vs 91.51.

Commands and outputs: see the review thread.

## Checklist

- [x] AI assistance used (Claude); commits carry `Co-authored-by: Claude`.
- [x] Design fit: one source file (plus tests); no core, scheduler or model-runner changes.
- [x] Tests: unit incl. real-allocator cases; E2E with/without the split, and an unaffected model.
- [x] Style: ruff, mypy, typos pass.
